prompts.label: First Android Studio project (Kotlin)
prompts.text:
I'm new to Android with Kotlin. Guide me to create the first app in Android Studio.

- New project: Empty Activity, Kotlin language, Gradle Kotlin DSL
- Explain app/src/main, MainActivity.kt, AndroidManifest.xml, build.gradle.kts
- Run on emulator; change greeting text
- Contrast with Java project layout in 2 bullets

Android Studio current version wording. List key files only.

prompts.label: Jetpack Compose Hello World
prompts.text:
Introduce Jetpack Compose for a Kotlin Android beginner.

- Enable Compose in new project or Empty Compose Activity template
- @Composable fun GreetingScreen with Column, Text, Button
- setContent { MaterialTheme { ... } } in MainActivity
- Explain declarative UI vs XML in 3 bullets

Minimal MainActivity.kt only.

prompts.label: remember and mutableStateOf counter
prompts.text:
Build a Compose counter button using remember { mutableStateOf(0) }.

- Button increments count, Text displays value
- Explain recomposition when state changes
- Brief state hoisting: pass count and onIncrement to child composable

No ViewModel yet — local state lesson.

prompts.label: LazyColumn list in Compose
prompts.text:
Show a scrollable list with LazyColumn in Compose.

- data class Item(val id: Int, val title: String)
- items(list) { item -> ListItem headline = item.title }
- Optional click lambda parameter
- Compare LazyColumn vs RecyclerView mentally for beginners

Fake in-memory list of 20 items.

prompts.label: Navigation Compose NavHost
prompts.text:
Wire Navigation Compose with two screens Home and Details.

- NavHost, NavController, rememberNavController
- composable("home") and composable("details/{id}") with navArgument
- Button navigates with navController.navigate

Dependencies: navigation-compose. Kotlin only.

prompts.label: ViewModel and StateFlow in Compose
prompts.text:
Connect ViewModel exposing StateFlow UI state to Compose.

- data class UiState(val items: List<String>, val loading: Boolean)
- viewModelScope.launch updates _uiState
- Screen uses viewModel() and collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
- Explain why StateFlow vs LiveData for Compose projects today

Simple list-loading fake delay example.

prompts.label: viewModelScope and coroutines
prompts.text:
Teach viewModelScope.launch for network/database work in Android ViewModel.

- Never block main thread; use Dispatchers.IO inside launch
- try/catch updating error state
- Cancelled when ViewModel cleared — explain briefly

Contrast with GlobalScope anti-pattern.

Base URL jsonplaceholder or similar public API.

- When monolith is still fine for beginners

prompts.label: Play Store release checklist Kotlin app
prompts.text:
Give a beginner checklist before publishing Kotlin Android app.

- Build signed AAB, versionCode/versionName
- ProGuard/R8 minify basics for release
- Privacy policy and data safety form mentions
- Test on real device matrix lightly
- Internal testing track first

No account-specific secrets.
